import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007L;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] input = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");
        int p_int = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int k_int = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);

        if (k_int == 0) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p_int, p_int - 1, MOD_CONST));
        } else if (k_int == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p_int, p_int, MOD_CONST));
        } else {
            long n = k_int;
            long order_count = 1;
            while (n != 1) {
                n = (n * k_int) % p_int;
                order_count++;
            }
            long repeats = (p_int - 1) / order_count;
            System.out.println(modPow(p_int, repeats, MOD_CONST));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
